Growth fintech companies stick the
landing
The second quarter of 2025 delivered a sharp
rebound for fintech stocks as markets shook off
tariff fears and surged to new highs. Growth
fintech names capitalized on renewed risk
appetite, with neobanks, brokers & crypto
platforms posting a median 101% return.
Consumer fintech operators, in particular, shone
by proving they can "min-max" their operations
by driving engagement and profitability while
keeping costs in check.
Fueled by the upturn, eToro, Circle, and Chime
seized the moment to break the IPO drought,
with Navan and Wealthfront poised to follow.
But the initial euphoria faded fast—only Circle
has stayed in the green since its debut, and
renewed tariff threats could slam the brakes on
the nascent growth rally.
Our Q2 2025 Fintech & Payments Public Comp
Sheet and Valuation Guide tracks metrics for key
publicly traded companies that include stock
performance, changes in valuation, historical
valuations, revenue growth, EBITDA growth, and
EBITDA margins. It is constructed using the
PitchBook Excel plugin available to subscribers.
